thread:
maria.pm: Quick sync — ACME private pilot needs a clear launch gate checklist. Customer legal wants KMS + on-prem image approval, runtime team needs prewarm SLA, infra needs staging quota pinned. Can we align on who owns each gate?
kevin.eng: I can own the runtime prewarm SLA proposal. Need input on target p95 and acceptable cost bump.
samir.runtime: For prewarm, proposal: 99th token latency <= 120ms end-to-end for 2k qps sustained, with a 15% cost overhead budget for warm pools. Is that acceptable to product/legal?
maria.pm: 120ms p99 is OK if infra can guarantee capacity. Legal: KMS + image approval is non-negotiable.
tina.infra: We can reserve a staging pool for the pilot, but we need a formal booking: start/end dates + expected GPU-hours. Also we need list of images to scan and target regions.
maria.pm: Tentative pilot window: May 4–18. GPU hours estimate: 1,500 over two weeks. Images: acme-model-v1, quantized-8bit-v1.
olivia.security: For KMS/HSM, we need a key-access policy doc and an attestation schedule. Also need to run image SBOM and sign-off from Vulnerability Review board. I can own the sign-off if we get SBOMs by Apr 20.
kevin.eng: I'll draft the prewarm SLA doc and add cost sensitivity matrix. Samir, can you add requirements for cache priming and KV-cache sizing?
samir.runtime: Yep. Quick config snippet for priming we'll use in the doc:
```
--prewarm.pool_size=64
--kv-cache-max-entries=200000
--prewarm-idle-ttl=45m
```
kevin.eng: perfect. I'll mock perf curves and show cost delta for pool sizes 32/64/128.
tina.infra: Booking note: please file a staging-capacity request ticket with the above dates + GPUs type (A100x2) and we can reserve. Without the ticket, we can't guarantee the pool.
maria.pm: Action items: 1) kevin draft SLA + cost matrix (due Apr 10) 2) samir append priming and kv-sizing (due Apr 8) 3) olivia run SBOM/sign-off process (need SBOM by Apr 20) 4) tina reserve staging pool (requires ticket by Apr 5). If any of you can't meet dates ping me.
kevin.eng: Ack — I'll start a doc in /docs/pilots/acme-private-sla and loop in infra for GPU spec. Will @tina once ticket created.
tina.infra: Will create the ticket today and include resource owner and backup.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging quota changes require 72h lead time and a change window approval.
maria.pm: Noted. If we need faster, we'll discuss contingency (burst on Dedicated). Any blockers?
olivia.security: No blockers beyond SBOM arrival. Also request: minimal network egress whitelist for the pilot.
maria.pm: Good call — adding network egress whitelist to the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
